hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Shear ring
function: The calibrated ring or stud that parts at the design load once the plug is fully set, releasing the tool from the plug.

tabs.overview: Shear value is set above the setting load and below the tool capacity.
tabs.safety: A wrong value leaves the tool attached or shears early.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
